source: Extracted SQL-only regression inputs from local commerce_v1_prompt_v3 synthetic runs; no runtime logs or database rows.

queries.customer_net:
SELECT customers.name, COALESCE(SUM(orders.gross_cents) - SUM(refunds.amount_cents), 0) AS net_cents
FROM customers
LEFT JOIN orders
ON customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
AND orders.status = 'paid'
AND orders.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01'
AND orders.ordered_at < '2026-02-01'
LEFT JOIN refunds
ON orders.order_id = refunds.order_id
GROUP BY customers.customer_id
ORDER BY customers.customer_id;
queries.empty_cohort: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(orders.gross_cents), 0) AS gross_cents FROM orders WHERE orders.status = 'paid' AND orders.ordered_at >= '2026-01-01' AND orders.ordered_at < '2026-02-01'
